jobs.title: Google Cloud Certified Professionals
jobs.description:
This is a remote position.  
 Comerit  is searching for Google Cloud Certified Professionals!  As the market is growing in the Google Cloud space, so are the number of projects for  Comerit  that are Google Cloud Platform based.  Specifically as we specialize in Data Transformation and Analytics, we would also prefer consultants with (GCP) BigQuery experience.  
 Although your GCP BigQuery experience may vary depending on the specific role and responsibilities assigned. However, here are some aspects of your BigQuery experience that may be relevant:  
 
 Querying and Analysis: Writing SQL-like queries to extract insights from large datasets stored in BigQuery. This involves understanding the data schema, performing complex aggregations, joins, and transformations, and optimizing queries for performance.  
 Data Loading and Extraction: Importing data from various sources into BigQuery, including files from Cloud Storage, streaming data from Pub/Sub, or data transfer from external systems. Similarly, exporting data from BigQuery to external destinations.  
 Data Transformation: Performing data preprocessing and transformation tasks using BigQuery's powerful SQL capabilities. This may involve data cleaning, normalization, denormalization, and creating derived tables or views.  
 Data Modeling and Schema Design: Designing and maintaining logical data models and schemas within BigQuery. This includes defining tables, partitions, and clustering strategies to optimize data storage and query performance.  
 Performance Optimization: Analyzing query execution plans, identifying bottlenecks, and optimizing query performance through techniques like partition pruning, caching, and query tuning.  
 Integration and Automation: Collaborating with other GCP services, such as Cloud Storage, Pub/Sub, Dataflow, or Data Studio, to build end-to-end data pipelines or integrate BigQuery with other systems. Automating job execution using scheduling tools or workflow frameworks like Cloud Composer or Cloud Data Fusion.  
 Monitoring and Troubleshooting: Monitoring the performance and health of BigQuery jobs, identifying and resolving issues related to data ingestion, query performance, or data consistency. Utilizing monitoring tools, logging, and error handling mechanisms.  
 Security and Compliance: Implementing appropriate security measures to protect sensitive data within BigQuery, adhering to data governance policies and compliance regulations. Managing access controls, data encryption, and auditing.  
 Documentation and Collaboration: Maintaining documentation, including data dictionaries, process flows, and technical specifications. Collaborating with cross-functional teams, including data engineers, data scientists, and business stakeholders, to understand requirements and deliver solutions.  
 Continuous Improvement: Staying up-to-date with the latest features and enhancements in BigQuery and related GCP services. Actively exploring opportunities to optimize data processing pipelines, enhance performance, and reduce costs.  
 
 If you are a Google Cloud Certified Professional, please apply and register.   Requirements 
 Any one of the following Google Cloud Platform Certifications:  
  Professional Cloud Architect Certification  
  Professional Data Engineer Certification  
  Professional Cloud Developer Certification  
  Professional Cloud Network Engineer Certification  
  Professional Cloud Security Engineer Certification  
  Professional Collaboration Engineer Certification  
  Professional Cloud DevOps Engineer  
  Google Cloud Certified Fellow: Hybrid Multi-Cloud  
  Professional Machine Learning Engineer  
 
 
 
 
 
  Originally posted on  Himalayas

  Axiom  is using zero-knowledge proofs to enable new types of verifiable and private software applications, starting with crypto and fintech. Our office is in NYC and working in person in NY is our strong preference, but we're open to remote candidates as well. 
 We recently released   OpenVM  , a performant and modular zkVM framework built for customization and extensibility. OpenVM allows developers to verify the correct execution of arbitrary computer programs in a flexible and performant way. We are building ZK-enabled products using OpenVM and supporting teams building on OpenVM. 

  The Role  
 We are looking for a  distributed systems engineer  to join a startup using zero-knowledge proofs to scale smart contract applications. You will be responsible for building Rust-based rollup nodes and sequencers to deliver zero-knowledge proof based products on-chain. Your work will require designing secure and efficient systems and making design choices to enable rapid development without sacrificing security. 
 We are looking for someone with strong engineering design skills, a security mindset, and the ability to design and implement blockchain protocols. We also value the ability to make pragmatic technology choices which empower our small team. 

  Who you are  
 
 
 You are fluent in Rust, C++, or a similarly performant backend language. We work primarily in Rust. 
 
 
 You have experience deploying and monitoring high uptime applications to production in the cloud using orchestration and containerization (Docker, Terraform, Kubernetes). 
 
 
 You have experience working within a large production codebase. 
 
 
 You are extremely detail oriented and have a security mindset. 
 
 
 You’re a clear communicator and value collaboration. 
 
 
 You have a bias towards action and extremely strong work ethic. 
 
 
  Bonuses  
 
 
 You have experience working with blockchain nodes like Geth, Reth, or similar.

 You’ll be working on groundbreaking tech that has the potential to be a key piece of infrastructure for the crypto industry 
 
 
 You’ll receive a competitive salary with equity 
 
 
 You will work with and receive mentorship from an exceptional team 
 
 
  Our Team
